title: A privileged login with a correct password returns an MFA challenge, not a usable session (enrolment required on first run)
evidence: status 200; mfaRequired true; enrollmentRequired true; companies present false

title: An unverified session is blocked from protected routes with mfa_enrollment_required (403)
Enrolment begins only with the current password (step-up) and returns an otpauth secret
evidence: wrong-pw 401; begin 200; secret len 32; uri otpauth://totp/Tegh%3Aowner%40gate.test?

title: Enrolment rejects an incorrect code (422 mfa_code_invalid)
A correct code confirms enrolment, verifies the session and returns 10 one-time recovery codes + the full identity
evidence: confirm 200; enabled true; recovery 10; identity true; protected-after 200

title: After enrolment, login is a two-step challenge for an *enrolled* account (mfaEnrolled true)
The second step rejects a wrong TOTP (422) and blocks the app until a correct code (verification_required)
A correct TOTP completes the second step and unlocks the app
A recovery code works as the second factor and is single-use (reuse is refused)
TOTP replay is refused: the same code cannot be used for a second verification in the same step
evidence: first 200; replay 422; same-step true (422 expected when same step)

title: Secrets at rest: the TOTP secret is stored encrypted (not the plaintext base32) and recovery codes are hashed
evidence: plaintext secret in cipher column 0; plaintext recovery stored 0; cipher bytes 32 (0/0 = encrypted & hashed)

title: An enrolled account cannot turn MFA off while its role still requires it (409)
evidence: disable 409/mfa_required_for_role (must stay on for privileged role)
